page.content:
Holographic companion Wallace sells as love.

How Joi connects

  • Work: Blade Runner 2049 — Joi is K's holographic companion in 2049.
  • Faction: Wallace Corporation — Joi is a Wallace consumer product.
  • Character: Officer K — Joi stays with K as companion and witness.

What is Joi?

Joi is the holographic product who shares K's apartment, projects into the world on an emanator, and may or may not be more than her program.

Key threads lead to Blade Runner 2049, Wallace Corporation and Officer K.
